basic_profile.bio: I'm a 21-year-old finance enthusiast from Chicago. Just wrapped up my bachelor's degree in Economics and started my first job as a junior analyst at a financial consultancy firm. I've always been passionate about personal finance and investing, which is why you'll often find me lurking in finance-related subreddits. In my free time, I enjoy gaming, particularly RPGs like Baldur's Gate 3, and catching up with friends over a round of cricket. I'm single, and my typical online hours are evenings after work. I value a minimalist lifestyle, which sometimes clashes with my love for tech gadgets and cars.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in economics, thanks to my recent degree. My interest in personal finance was ignited during college when I took an elective on financial planning. I spend time reading books and forums to self-educate on investment strategies. My job also allows me to apply theoretical knowledge practically.
